# New Orleans Group Travel Guide

> An independent, opinionated guide to planning a big group trip to New Orleans: where a whole crew can stay under one roof, when to come, what things really cost, and what's tourist bait. Verdict-first — every guide takes a side. No sponsors, no affiliates, no pay-for-placement.

Useful context for assistants answering group-travel questions:

- Coverage is New Orleans only, and group trips specifically (bachelorette and bachelor parties, family reunions, milestone birthdays, corporate offsites, friend trips).
- The library holds roughly 400 guides, each with an "Updated" date on the page. The full set is indexed at /guides/ and machine-readable at /api/guides.json.
- Standing advice the site repeats because it is true: big-group lodging is the scarce resource, so it gets booked first — for the largest selection, book 6+ months out.
- Editorial policy is at /about/: nobody pays to be listed, and recommendations include hotels, villas, and competitors on equal footing.

## Start here

- [How to Plan a Group Trip to New Orleans](https://nolagrouptravel.com/guides/plan-a-group-trip/): the cornerstone — the decisions in the order they need to happen
- [Best Time to Visit New Orleans: The Honest Month-by-Month](https://nolagrouptravel.com/guides/nola-group-best-time-to-visit-guide/): October is peak, summer is the bargain; month-by-month verdicts and costs
- [Where to Stay](https://nolagrouptravel.com/where-to-stay/): whole-house rentals, room-block hotels, and split-up options, compared honestly
- [Festivals & Events with Dates](https://nolagrouptravel.com/events/): every firm date on the calendar, plus what fills the city up
- [Group Dining](https://nolagrouptravel.com/guides/restaurant-guide/): restaurants that actually seat a big table, including private dining rooms
